briefing.headline: OpenAI and Google DeepMind accelerate frontier scaling amid regulatory scrutiny

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: The AI race intensifies with major model releases and compute investments dominating headlines. Frontier labs push boundaries while safety concerns mount over deployment risks.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI's o3-pro and Anthropic's Claude 4.5 set new benchmarks in reasoning. xAI Colossus expansion and DeepSeek's latest open weights release heighten competition.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems and DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level. EU AI Act enforcement begins with new vulnerability disclosures.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: NVIDIA Blackwell ramp and new TSMC Arizona fab announcements drive supply. Microsoft and Google commit to additional gigawatt-scale data centers.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will multi-agent protocol standards like DialectForge become mandatory for critical infrastructure by 2028?
